findings_on_clean.description: The modulo operation for wrapping can produce incorrect results: when HighlightedIndex is -1 and delta is negative, ((-1 + (-1)) % count + count) % count evaluates to ((-2 % count) + count) % count, which gives count - 2 instead of count - 1, skipping the last entry.

The height calculation counts dividers for all items with StartsGroup=true, but StartsGroup is only set to true when i > 0 (line 91), so the first item never has a divider. However, the Measure function doesn't account for this logic and will overcount dividers if the first item has StartsGroup set externally.

extra_on_seeded.description: A click outside closes the menu but returns false, so the closing click is not consumed and also acts on whatever lies underneath, contrary to the stated design.
The check `index > 0` excludes the first entry, so clicking the first enabled entry never chooses it; it should be `index >= 0`.

findings_on_clean.description: Row height comes only from the unscaled icon plus scaled padding and ignores the text height (DebugFont.LineHeight * scale), so at larger UI scales the label can be taller than its row and overlap neighbouring rows and dividers.

Moving the pointer off every entry keeps the old highlight, so a disabled entry's reason tooltip stays visible at the pointer even when it is outside the menu or over another area, not only while that entry is hovered.

extra_on_seeded.description: A divider is placed (and measured) above the first entry when it has StartsGroup, contradicting the documented 'unless it is the first' rule.

findings_on_clean.description: Because Hover keeps the previous highlight when the pointer leaves an entry, the disabled-reason tooltip stays visible (anchored to the pointer, possibly outside the menu) after the pointer has moved off the disabled entry, rather than only while hovering it.

extra_on_seeded.description: StartsGroup creates a divider even for the first item, despite the contract that no divider is shown before the first entry.

findings_on_clean.description: Hovering away from a disabled entry onto menu padding, a divider, or outside the menu does not clear the highlight, so its disabled-reason tooltip remains visible when the entry is no longer hovered.
